FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Minimize Taxation
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: Collect less taxes from your settlements. This will make them happier and reduce unrest.

FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Heavy Taxation
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: Increase the amount of taxes on your settlements at the cost of happiness and unrest.

FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Goods Economy
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: Settlements prioritize sending physical goods over silver. Tithe budgets increase significantly, but silver income decreases.

FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Silver Standard
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: Settlements sell goods locally and remit coin instead. Silver income increases, but tithe budgets are reduced.
